description: This file defines ASN.1 structures and classes related to 3GPP RRC NR paging messages, including paging records, identities, and groupings, for use in 5G NR protocol implementation.

classes.name: group_paging_r18_s
classes.description: Represents a group paging structure with a flag for inactive reception.

classes.name: paging_ue_id_c
classes.description: Represents a choice of paging UE identity, either 5G S-TMSI or full I-RNTI.

classes.name: paging_record_s
classes.description: Represents a paging record containing UE ID and related info.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the structure into a bit buffer.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Deserializes the structure from a bit buffer.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Converts the structure to JSON format.
